name: Lefay Resort & SPA Dolomiti
positioning: Mountain resort in Pinzolo, Trentino, set in the UNESCO-listed Dolomites and linked to the Madonna di Campiglio ski area
best_for: Skiers who want the Madonna di Campiglio ski area with a free transfer to the Pinzolo lifts
Summer hikers and active travelers interested in golf, horse riding and mountain biking

facts.text: The resort's address is Via Alpe di Grual 16, in Pinzolo.
The Madonna di Campiglio ski area has 150 km of slopes and 4 snowboard parks.
A single ski pass covers the whole Madonna di Campiglio ski area, the biggest in Trentino.
The region is known for hosting sports competitions such as the Alpine Ski World Cup.
In winter, the area's glaciers and snow-capped peaks suit skiers of all levels.
In summer, the green mountains of the Dolomites are a setting for hikers.
The resort has a meeting centre with a large room for groups and a boardroom, both fully equipped with the latest technology and a dedicated foyer.
The Main Restaurant offers a room for events.

highlights.text: The resort is set in the scenery of the Dolomites, which UNESCO declared a World Heritage Site.
Guests can take a free private transfer to and from the Pinzolo ski lifts.
The resort has a Ski Room and its own ski shop, where guests can hire equipment or buy snow accessories and ski passes.
Two 9-hole golf courses are a few minutes from the resort.
Guests looking for adventure can choose horse riding and mountain bike excursions.

considerations.text: Golf is off-site: the two 9-hole courses are a few minutes from the resort.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires advance planning for transportation.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing at the higher end of the market.
